verdict.rationale: Codex cloud explicitly supports running tasks in parallel across isolated cloud environments without tying up the local machine, which is the closest evidence to bulk/parallel operations, but there's no documentation of true bulk operations across many items (e.g., batch processing across many repos/files/tasks in one command) or independent corroboration of scale. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation tooling, evidence of scaling to many concurrent items, and hands-on confirmation of parallel task throughput.
